subject: 🏃 Tuesday — 4 mi Easy / Deload Day 2 (Wk 8)
html:
Tomorrow you have 4 miles easy — HR Zone 2 (135–145), pace ~9:15–9:30. No track work this week; the body is still clearing the Presidio HM from Sunday. Run from the door on the hilly home roads — let pace float on the climbs (it'll read slower than 9:30 uphill, faster downhill), but keep HR parked in that 135–145 band. If the hills pull HR above 145, walk or slow to a shuffle until it drops back down. This is a recovery run, not a fitness run.

Pre-run activation (5 min): quadruped hip CARs, banded lateral walks (10 each direction), glute bridges (10), plus quadruped banded hip IR (5–10 reps each side, PT-prescribed). Lay out clothes and shoes tonight so you can roll out the door easily in the morning.

Focus cue: how do the legs feel 48 hours post-HM? Sunday's 1:38 on the hilly bridge course was a genuine effort — suffer score 235, highest of the plan. The quads and calves may still be carrying residual soreness from the bridge descents. Note any post-race heaviness (normal and expected) vs. knee chatter (log it — the eccentric descent load can announce itself at 48 hours). Last reported knee: 1/5 crossing the line at Presidio. If it's still 1/5 tomorrow, great. If it ticks to 2, double the mobility flush and note it — but don't skip the run for a lone 2.

Where you are: Week 8 of 12, deload week, day 2. 33 days to race day (July 26). The Presidio pivot is in the books — holding 3:30, paces stay VDOT 54. The engine proved it can run the distance and the knee passed clean on a demanding course. The one thing to fix in the back half: fueling at race effort (one gel in 97 min at Presidio). That project starts with Sunday's 10-miler when we rehearse gels at easy effort. For now, just recover.

Tonight: Good recovery dinner — protein + carbs (fish, rice, roasted veg). Hydrate. Bed by 10. Tomorrow is low-key.
